C# Developer
Role Overview:

We are seeking a skilled Developer to join the team. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills and experience in web technologies, scripting, and database fundamentals.


Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain applications using C# within Visual Studio.
Build responsive web interfaces using HTML and JavaScript.
Create and optimize PowerShell scripts for automation tasks.
Collaborate with team members to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Work in an Agile environment, actively participating in sprints and stand-ups.
Document technical solutions and maintain code repositories.


Required Skills:

Proficiency in C# development.
Strong knowledge of HTML and JavaScript.
Experience with PowerShell scripting.
Familiarity with Visual Studio IDE.
Basic understanding of database concepts.
Exposure to Jira for task management.
Excellent teamworking and communication skills.
